description: Independently review whether a single female live-fly DNa02 electrophysiology file with 165 labeled-in-time 500-ms light pulses but no left/right trial labels can validate a male-connectome MuJoCo 335-ms chemical odor steering assay. Inspect exact source/protocol differences and identify the narrow valid comparison.

Derive and implement a numerical active-set or analytic-decay motor architecture for a heterogeneous recurrent connectome. Input is an existing GPU q/s graph in which about 75% of 166700 neurons have q>0.01 at stored times; preserve event cuts, coupling and arbitrary mass/port models. Supply executable code, counterexamples and cost benchmark.

Write and run a local readback across the four saved full-organism odor-left, odor-right, uniform and sham trajectories. Verify anatomical side metadata and find the first interface where signed lateral contrast fails between ORNs, central neurons, descending DNa02, applied command and body yaw. No new gain tuning.
